proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_combined_passive_and_activation
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has an always-on passive rider and a separate turn-gated activated capability. Current magic items must choose exactly one mechanics family: passive or activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding or wearing this talisman, you have Advantage on any Intelligence (Arcana) check you make to control a Sphere of Annihilation. In addition, when you start your turn in control of a Sphere of Annihilation, you can take a Magic action to move it..."

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.object
proposed_widenings.justification: The activated half targets and moves another specific object, not self, a creature target, an area, or a mark.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can take a Magic action to move it"

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.move_object
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface lacks an authored way to express deterministic movement of an external object with a distance formula derived from an ability modifier.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "move it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier"

notes: Did not author placeholder content. The passive Arcana-check advantage fits existing atoms, but the item as a whole cannot be represented honestly because the current magic-item surface cannot combine passive and activated mechanics, and the activation moves an object tied to control-state over a Sphere of Annihilation.
